name: 52302 · Marion, IA
findings: ZIP 52302 (Marion) has 106 nonprofit organizations. 40 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 52302 (Marion) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 52302 (Marion) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 56% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 65 organizations here; 23% of all organizations here have no identified type.
